fault-state.description: Overall fault state: `OK`, `FAULT`, `UNKNOWN`. Publishers MAY extend the value set via `$format` for device-specific fault categories.

communication-state.description: The publisher's view of its own communication / link health, to the device it represents (for a proxy) or to its backhaul (for a native device): `OK`, `DEGRADED`, `LOST`, `UNKNOWN`. Orthogonal to whether the eBus publisher is currently reporting to *its* consumers.

active-alerts.description: Human-readable current alert(s), when the device exposes them.
